title: Mirabel and the Veil
author: Isandro Lockridge
blurb: Jonah Fairweather, an exiled storm-caller, has spent twelve years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
